description: This file contains a PHPUnit test suite for the Gitlab OAuth2 provider client, including setup, URL generation, token handling, user data retrieval, and exception handling.

classes.name: GitlabTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the Gitlab OAuth2 provider implementation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the Gitlab provider instance with mock client credentials before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up mock objects after each test.

methods.name: testShorthandedSelfhostedConstructor
methods.description: Tests constructor with custom domain for self-hosted Gitlab.

methods.name: testAuthorizationUrl
methods.description: Verifies the generated authorization URL contains expected query parameters.

methods.name: testScopes
methods.description: Tests that scope array is correctly included in the authorization URL.

methods.name: testGetAuthorizationUrl
methods.description: Ensures the authorization URL contains the correct path.

methods.name: testGetBaseAccessTokenUrl
methods.description: Checks the access token URL path.

methods.name: testGetAccessToken
methods.description: Mocks the token response, verifies token object properties.

methods.name: testSelfHostedGitlabDomainUrls
methods.description: Tests URL generation for a self-hosted Gitlab instance including authorization, token, and user info URLs.

methods.name: testUserData
methods.description: Simulates fetching user data and verifies resource owner attributes.

methods.name: testApiClient
methods.description: Checks that the resource owner returns an API client instance.

methods.name: testExceptionThrownWhenErrorObjectReceived
methods.description: Tests handling of an error response with a message payload, expecting an exception.

methods.name: testExceptionThrownWhenOAuthErrorReceived
methods.description: Tests handling of an OAuth error response, expecting an exception.
